messages:
Sam: quick bakeoff update — tried mixing AWQ/GPTQ/FP8 with prefix prefetch + continuous batching on r3-70b. latency looks better but accuracy swings on long contexts.

Nina: which eval set and config?

Sam: regression slice (12k prod-like prompts), mostly chat/history + few long-form. config I ran: 
```
model: r3-70b
quant: awq / fp8 / gptq variants
prefetch: enabled
prefetch_window: 64
batching: continuous, max_latency_ms=40
```

Ajay: baseline numbers? did you try turning prefetch off? continuous batching can change KV timing.

Sam: baseline float16 no prefetch: median latency 105ms, p95 320ms, MRR delta 0. AWQ alone no prefetch: -0.8% MRR. AWQ + prefetch (w=64): -2.4% MRR. FP8 alone: -1.1%. FP8 + prefetch: -0.4% (improved vs fp8 alone). GPTQ was ~-0.9% w/ or w/out prefetch.

Frank: so FP8 benefits from prefetch but AWQ degrades. suggests quant-type interacts with cached KV fidelity. do you have per-length breakdown?

Sam: yes — short prompts (<64 tokens) basically flat. mid (64-512) small dip ~-0.6%. long (>512) worst: AWQ+prefetch hit ~-3.6% MRR.

Nina: AWQ is likely introducing layer-wise noise that compounds when KV from prefetch is re-used across many steps.

Ajay: two safe knobs to try: (A) hybrid-KV where keys kept fp16 and values quantized, (B) reduce prefetch window for AWQ profiles (16/32). also flip continuous batching off to isolate batching effect.

Sam: ran quick hybrid-KV (keys fp16, values AWQ): AWQ+hybrid-prefetch w=64 -> MRR delta -0.9% (much better), latency still ~20% lower than baseline. memory increase ~+7% for keys.

Frank: good tradeoff. ops could enable prefetch for FP8/GPTQ and only use hybrid-KV for AWQ. what about cost/memory numbers?

Sam: hybrid-KV increases RAM by ~7-9% on node, GPU memory similar. Ops cost negligible relative to reserved infra.

Nina: please create a short experiment ticket with configs, perf tables, and a handful of failing prompt examples. Recommend blocking AWQ+full-prefetch on r3 until we have hybrid-KV or tightened prefetch windows. Also add an alert for long-context MRR regressions on quant variants.

Sam: filing now — ticket link: https://redwood.example/tickets/RI-1246 (will attach artifacts).

deploy-bot: perf-suite complete: run_id=2026-03-20-01, median=76ms (baseline 105ms), p95=210ms (baseline 320ms), overall MRR delta -1.5%, long-context bucket -3.4%.

Ajay: next steps: (1) reproduce with continuous batching disabled, (2) sweep hybrid-KV across prefetch windows [16,32,64], (3) try AWQ+GPTQ mixed quant if runtime supports hybrid layer quant.

ci-bot: scheduled nightly job: quant-prefetch-compare (variants: baseline, awq, fp8, awq-hybrid-kv) ETA ~10h.

Sam: adding chat-thread synthetic workload to stress harness to simulate repeated prefix reuse (should expose KV drift). Posting results in morning. tagging @Nina @Frank for prioritization.

Frank: if hybrid-KV holds across windows, ops can enable prefetch broadly and only special-case AWQ full-quant profiles.

Nina: agreed. thanks for the thorough diffs.

Sam: will summarize in an RFC if overnight runs look stable and we'll propose the hybrid-KV default for AWQ. closing loop tomorrow.
